1. Preamble

Chapter I: Preliminary

1. Preamble

These Directions govern widget loans1 made through mobile apps.

2. Cooling-off period

i. A borrower may exit a widget loan within a cooling-off period of not less than three days.

ii. The lender may keep a one-time processing fee of up to 100 rupees.

Customer liability

3. A customer reporting fraud within two working days has zero liability.

DelayLiability
Within 2 daysZero
3 to 5 daysRs 5,000

3.1 Banks shall resolve complaints within 60 days.

3.1.1 Interest shall not be lost by the customer during the review.
